description: This file is a shell script for configuring QoS (Quality of Service) rules on OpenWrt network devices, involving functions to load network configurations, manipulate iptables/ip6tables rules, and set up network interfaces and classes.

methods.name: add_insmod
methods.description: Loads a kernel module if it is not already loaded, using either insmod or modprobe.

methods.name: find_ifname
methods.description: Retrieves the network device name for a given interface, or exits if not found.

methods.name: parse_matching_rule
methods.description: Constructs iptables rules based on matching conditions and options.

methods.name: config_cb
methods.description: Configuration callback to set default interface parameters.

methods.name: qos_parse_config
methods.description: Parses QoS configuration entries and sets up interfaces and rules accordingly.

methods.name: enum_classes
methods.description: Enumerates classes within a QoS class group and assigns class numbers.

methods.name: cls_var
methods.description: Assigns class-specific variables from configuration, with defaults.

methods.name: tcrules
methods.description: Generates traffic control rules using an awk script.

methods.name: start_interface
methods.description: Initializes and starts QoS configuration on a specific network interface.

methods.name: start_interfaces
methods.description: Initializes and starts QoS configuration on all interfaces.

methods.name: add_rules
methods.description: Adds specific iptables rules based on configured rules and targets.

methods.name: start_cg
methods.description: Starts QoS settings for a particular class group.

methods.name: start_firewall
methods.description: Sets up firewall rules for QoS, including chain creation and rule insertion.

methods.name: stop_firewall
methods.description: Removes QoS-related firewall rules and chains.
